_comment: Expansion 3 part F.2: the summoned spirits of spell levels 2-4 (docs/expansions/03-demigods-magics.md), from the 2024 Player's Handbook. The 'ally' op with kind 'summon' calls rules/allies.summon_spirit: the creature's numbers for the slot come from its 'summon' record (creatures.allies.json), it appears at the point and goes when the concentration ends. The spirits' own magic (classes 'creature': no scroll, no spellbook) is at the end.

summon_beast.name: Summon Beast

material.text: a gilded acorn worth 200+ GP with a feather, a tuft of fur and a fish tail inside

summon_beast.text: A bestial spirit of the land (Pack Tactics, climbs), the air (flies, Flyby) or the water fights for you while you concentrate: AC 11 + the slot level, 30 hit points (20 in the air) + 5 a slot above 2, half the slot level in Rends of 1d8 + 4 + the slot level.

summon_fey.name: Summon Fey
summon_fey.text: A fey spirit fights for you while you concentrate: AC 12 + the slot level, 30 hit points + 10 a slot above 3, Fey Blades of 2d6 + 3 + the slot level. Its Fey Step (30 feet) brings by its mood an advantage (Fuming), a foe charmed (Mirthful) or darkness (Tricksy).

summon_undead.name: Summon Undead
summon_undead.text: An undead spirit fights for you while you concentrate: AC 11 + the slot level, 30 hit points (20 if skeletal) + 10 a slot above 3. Putrid, it poisons those beside it and its claw paralyses the poisoned; ghostly, it flies and frightens; skeletal, it shoots 150 feet.

summon_aberration.name: Summon Aberration

material.text: a pickled tentacle and an eyeball in a platinum-inlaid vial worth 400+ GP

summon_aberration.text: An aberrant spirit fights beside you while you concentrate: AC 11 + the slot level, 40 hit points and 10 more for each slot above 4. A slaad regenerates and its claws stop healing; a beholderkin floats and shoots eye rays 150 feet; a mind flayer's whispers hurt everyone beside it but you.

summon_construct.name: Summon Construct
summon_construct.text: A construct spirit of clay, metal or stone fights beside you while you concentrate: AC 13 + the slot level, 40 hit points and 15 more for each slot above 4, a Slam of 1d8 + 4 + the slot level. Metal burns those who strike it; stone slows the foes beside it; clay lashes back at whoever hurts it.

summon_elemental.name: Summon Elemental

material.text: a gold-inlaid vial worth 400+ GP holding air, a pebble, ash and water

summon_elemental.text: An elemental spirit of air, earth, fire or water fights for you while you concentrate: AC 11 + the slot level, 50 hit points + 10 a slot above 4, Slams of 1d10 + 4 + the slot level in its element. The game picks the element that hurts the foes most.

giant_insect.name: Giant Insect
giant_insect.text: A giant centipede, spider or wasp fights for you while you concentrate (10 minutes): AC 11 + the slot level, 30 hit points + 10 a slot level, Poison Jabs reaching 10 feet (1d6 + 3 + the slot level, and 1d4 poison). A spider's Web Bolt roots, a centipede spews poison, a wasp flies.

fey_step_fuming.name: Fey Step
fey_step_fuming.text: A fuming fey spirit steps through the world up to 30 feet and has Advantage on its next attack this turn.

fey_step_mirthful.name: Fey Step
fey_step_mirthful.text: A mirthful fey spirit steps through the world up to 30 feet; a foe it sees within 10 feet makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed for a minute, until it takes damage.

fey_step_tricksy.name: Fey Step
fey_step_tricksy.text: A tricksy fey spirit steps through the world up to 30 feet and fills a 10-foot cube beside it with magical Darkness until the end of its next turn.

venomous_spew.name: Venomous Spew
venomous_spew.text: A giant centipede spits venom at a creature within 10 feet: a Constitution save, or Poisoned until the start of the centipede's next turn.
